name: massed-compute-management-ui
description: Massed Compute Management UI — multi-tenant GPU rental proxy in front of one Massed Compute account

SESSION_SECRET.description: Long random string that signs sign-in sessions. Generate one: `openssl rand -base64 32`.

DATA_KEY.description: Long random string that encrypts the stored Massed Compute tokens. **Never change it later**, or the Massed connection must be redone.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Your email. The first admin account is created for this address, then you attach Massed Compute.
